craft_notes: Sthāyin: doubt-verse (the engine). Rows: row 3 (even-now/not — negation held into line 2). Rupture: dash after me — duration, then the question. Close: end-weight on digit (the odd made-of). Minimal pass: none. Read aloud: still — what? Rejected: 'cognition' for rūpa — killed: form kept; softening to 'questions' — killed: saṃśaya is doubt, live.

lines: Even now the doubt is not dispelled in me —
what form is it in truth, made of word-heap and digit?
l4.sanskrit_cite: adyāpi na nivṛtto me saṃśayaḥ parameśvara | kiṃ rūpaṃ tattvato deva śabdarāśikalāmayam
